subject.title: fix(secrets): add audit check severity threshold

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `openclaw secrets audit --severity-min` threshold that lets opt-in automation pass despite lower-severity secrets-audit findings?
rationale: The implementation is default-compatible and well covered, but deciding whether info-level secrets-audit findings may be non-blocking is a security/product policy choice for the secrets audit surface.

options.title: Sponsor current threshold
options.body: A secrets/security owner accepts the opt-in policy and the PR can proceed with the current default-compatible flag, tests, docs, and terminal proof.

options.title: Request narrower gate
options.body: Ask for a smaller owner-approved policy, such as limiting the threshold to specific finding classes or aligning it with a broader audit/doctor design.

options.title: Close until policy exists
options.body: Close or pause the contributor PR if maintainers do not want to sponsor a new public audit threshold now.

recommendation.title: Sponsor current threshold
recommendation.body: A secrets/security owner accepts the opt-in policy and the PR can proceed with the current default-compatible flag, tests, docs, and terminal proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the clearest feature-history connection to the secrets audit flow and its CLI/docs contract.
